# Journal Recorder

Shared safe summary core. Python stdlib. Private Markdown source, exact owned file commits, outgoing Git history scan. Renderer lives in separate decision-ledger-setup repo.

Claude Stop/PostCompact and Codex notify capture supported. Codex needs exact thread ID and cwd. Cursor afterAgentResponse reads final text. Gemini AfterAgent reads prompt plus reply. Copilot and other agents use manual stdin JSON or shared skill. Native routes tested with fake payloads. No live agent app capture smoke claimed.

Known secrets scrubbed before model, temp and save. Reply and metadata scrub again. Model failure skips entry. No raw fallback. Bad local policy blocks; missing policy uses builtins only. Pattern scan cannot prove all prose safe. Model and private Git send data off machine.

Root lock spans save and sync. Busy writer exits for later retry. Commit holds exact scanned bytes in private Git index. Push scans original outgoing Git objects, commit headers and paths against isolated fetched baseline. Existing staged changes block commit. Existing HOME.md edits stay local. Output writes reject symlinks. Failed sync keeps local Markdown, returns failure and leaves dedup marker unchanged. Retry may create second entry.

Need macOS or Linux, Python 3.10+, Git and Bash. Full suite needs Python 3.11+. Install from reviewed checkout with bash install.sh --agents claude,codex,cursor,gemini. Manual route needs no model. Claude CLI used for automatic summaries. Codex writer needs explicit JOURNAL_ALLOW_CODEX=1 and has weaker isolation.

Optional Microsoft APM ships root manual skill plus core, no universal hook activation. APM 0.30.0 GitHub install at 8665f4bbf108edda89b61f85f70a016f6485637f passed five targets: claude,codex,copilot,cursor,gemini. Both deployed core copies passed fake record, scrub and local bare Git push in temp home. Real hooks and settings unchanged.

Checks: 62 tests pass, 82% line coverage. Python compile, Bash syntax and diff whitespace pass. Fake credentials, temp HOME and local remotes only. No live provider call.

Source and current steps: https://github.com/GauravRatnawat/journal-recorder-agent
Renderer: https://github.com/GauravRatnawat/decision-ledger-setup
